```text

```

`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` が必要です。

Skill({skill: "dev-graph:run-dev-graph-decompose", args: "--repo-root /Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/HarnessHub/.worktrees/task-20260725-054631-wt-2/eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/decompose-wt2-v12r4 --binding none --dry-run"})

`/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/HarnessHub/.worktrees/task-20260725-054631-wt-2/eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/decompose-wt2-v12r4/eval-log/macro-preview.json`

  --repo-root /Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/HarnessHub/.worktrees/task-20260725-054631-wt-2/eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/decompose-wt2-v12r4 \

     3→description: 大きな自然文構想を feature・architecture・機能間依存へマクロ分解したいとき、ready feature の system-dev-planner package を atomic 登録・binding 別投影したいときに使う。

    10→user-invocable: true

    12→allowed-tools: [Read, Write, Bash, Skill, AskUserQuestion, Agent]
    13→script_refs: [../../scripts/resolve-repo-context.py, ../../scripts/validate-graph-schema.py, ../../scripts/gh-bridge.py, ../../scripts/bd-bridge.py]
    14→schema_refs: [../../schemas/graph-node.schema.json]

    20→  - prompts/R3-decompose.md

    28→  - id: R2-plan
    29→    name: plan
    30→    prompt_required: true

    33→    name: feature-planning
    34→    prompt_required: true

    40→  - id: R4-project
    41→    name: project
    42→    prompt_required: true
    43→    summary: "tracker_binding=githubかつissue_and_projectsのtaskだけをconfigured Projectsへ冪等追加し、Statusはlocal_to_projectで初期化する。beads mirrorとnoneはProject mutationしない"

    45→    name: retry
    46→    prompt_required: false

    95→      verify_by: test

    98→# run-dev-graph-decompose
    99→
   100→## Purpose & Output Contract
   101→
   102→- 入力: 大きな want、feature 粒度/依存方針、C24/C11 検証済み graph context、任意の system-dev-planner package。
   103→- 出力: feature/architecture/機能間 DAG の macro report、ready feature ごとの exact-13 package receipt、binding 別 publication report。
   104→- 完了条件: macro DAG に phase-task 混入0、ready package が P01..P13 exact-set、自動/手動経路の二重登録0、dry-run write 0 である。
   105→
   106→## Hard boundary
   107→
   108→dev-graph はマクロ層: purpose/goal/scope/acceptance を持つ feature、共有 architecture node、feature 間 `depends_on` を所有する。system-dev-planner はミクロ層: **1 feature から P01..P13 の13 task specs/DAG/package** を所有する。本 skill が phase task を独自生成してはならない。
   109→
   110→## Macro flow
   111→
   112→1. 大きな want、feature 粒度、依存推定方針、dry-run を確認する。
   113→2. want を feature 候補と architecture context に分解し、各 feature に `purpose/goal/scope_in/scope_out/acceptance/architecture_refs` を付ける。循環と実装粒度の task 混入を独立 auditor で拒否する。
   114→3. C02 preview/atomic writer で macro graph を登録する。draft/unconfirmed/readiness incomplete は tracker 投影しない。
   115→4. feature 間依存が満たされた ready feature ごとに `run-system-dev-plan` を Skill 呼出しする。`--manual-plan`/`/system-dev-plan` 結果も同じ package gate へ入れる。
   116→5. P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、13-node DAG、source digest を検証し、C02 `register-package` へ渡す。`graph_node_id+source_digest` で自動/手動の二重登録を防ぐ。
   117→6. `beads` は C28 create/dep-add、`github` は C12 Issue/任意 Projects、`none` は local only。mode=both+auto、github+local_only、beads+GitHub Issue mutation は fail-closed。
   118→
   119→local commit 後の外部失敗は rollback せず node/operation 単位 pending_retry。`--dry-run` は local/Beads/GitHub write 0。出力は macro report、per-feature package receipt、publication report。
   120→
   121→`--dry-run` の preview graph を C11 検証するときは、管理対象 repo へ一時ファイルを書かず **stdin 経路**を使う。`--graph FILE` は `contained(graph, repo_root)` を要求するため、preview を file 経由で検証すると必ず write が発生し `--dry-run write 0` 契約を破る (書いて直後に unlink しても write count は0にならない)。
   122→
   123→```bash
   124→printf '%s' "$PREVIEW_GRAPH_JSON" \
   125→  | python3 "$DEV_GRAPH_PLUGIN/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py" --graph - --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT"
   126→```
   127→
   128→## ゴールシーク実行
   129→
   130→### ゴール (Goal)
   131→
   132→自然文の「やりたいこと(大)」からfeatureノード群+architectureノード+機能間depends_onを生成するマクロ分解を行い、ready featureごとにsystem-dev-planner(ミクロ層)を自動起動または手動`/system-dev-plan`実行結果を受理してpromoted typed task群をparent_feature付きでC02へatomic登録し、binding=beadsはC28へissue/依存edge、binding=githubはC12へIssue/任意Projects、binding=noneはローカルのみへ冪等投影した状態になっている
   133→
   134→### 目的・背景 (Why)
   135→
   136→マクロ (feature/architecture/機能間依存の保持+実行オーケストレーション) とミクロ (1 feature→13タスク仕様書) の責務混線を避けるため、C14は自然文のwantをfeature+architecture+機能間depends_onへ分解するところまでを担い、feature単位の細タスク仕様書生成はexternal plugin system-dev-planner (external_contract_ref: plugin-plans/system-dev-planner/handoff-run-plugin-dev-plan.json) へ委譲する。ready feature (機能間depends_on充足) ごとに [自動] run-system-dev-planをSkill呼出しでpurpose/goal/scope_in/scope_out/acceptance/architecture_refsを入力文脈として渡し、[手動] 人間の`/system-dev-plan`実行結果も同じ入口として受理する。両経路が返すpromoted typed taskはgraph_node_id+source_digestを冪等キーにC02単一writer経由でparent_feature=当該featureとしてatomic登録し、二重登録を防ぐ。既存の「自然文とpromoted system taskの入口一本化」責務は維持し、tracker_binding_intentはC02がrepo-configと照合して解決し、mode=bothのautoは拒否する。beadsはC28 create/dep-add、githubはC12 Issue/Projects、noneはlocal graphだけへ投影する。GitHub binding+local_onlyは未管理taskを生むため拒否する
   137→
   138→### 完了チェックリスト
   139→
   140→- [ ] macro result が feature/architecture/機能間 depends_on だけを持ち循環と phase-task 混入が0件である
   141→- [ ] draft/unconfirmed/evaluation非pass/readiness非complete の tracker publication が0件である

   144→- [ ] beads/github/none の各 task が単一 projection authority と linkage を持つ
   145→- [ ] `--dry-run` の local/Beads/GitHub/Projects write count が0である (preview 検証は `--graph -` の stdin 経路を使い、一時ファイルの作成→削除も write として数える)
   146→
   147→### ゴールシークループ
   148→
   149→frontmatter の `goal_seek.engine: inline` / `fork: subagent` / `max_loops: 5` を実行契約とする。固定手順は使わず、未達 checklist と担当 `prompts/*.md` からその周回の操作を都度生成する。各周回で inner criterion を検証し、完了後は outer criterion の live trial/content review を最大 `feedback_contract.max_iterations=3` 周で評価する。
   150→
   151→### ゴールシーク配線
   152→
   153→- 開始時に C24 `resolve-repo-context.py --mode write` の JSON receipt を得て、`repo_root` が `content_roots.repository` の realpath と一致する場合だけ `DEV_GRAPH_ROOT=<receipt.repo_root>` に固定する。cwd から再解決しない。
   154→- 元のゴールを `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-goal-spec.json` へ、各 checklist の status/evidence を `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-progress.json` へ記録する。
   155→- 未達 responsibility を担当する `prompts/<R-id>.md` を読み、`Agent` で分離 context に fork する。ユーザー判断が必要な境界だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。
   156→- 各周回末に `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-intermediate.jsonl` へ `original_goal`、`original_goal_hash`、`current_goal_snapshot`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を append-only で記録する。次周回は直前の `merged_directive_for_next` を必須入力にする。
   157→- 5周到達時に未達が残れば完了扱いせず、progress と blocker を親へ handoff する。全 checklist と `feedback_contract.criteria` が PASS のときだけ完了する。
   158→
   159→### ゴールシーク検証
   160→
   161→各周回後に次の検査を実行し、中間成果物の欠落・goal drift・hash 不一致を fail-closed にする。
   162→
   163→```bash
   164→python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
   165→import hashlib, json, sys
   166→goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
   167→rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
   168→required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
   169→expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
   170→assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
   171→for row in rows:
   172→    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
   173→    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
   174→    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
   175→PY
   176→```
   177→
   178→## Criteria acceptance
   179→
   180→- `criteria:IN1`: `validate-graph-schema.py`で生成nodeを検証し必須キー欠落が0件である。
   181→- `criteria:OUT1`: `feature+architecture` DAGは循環なし・task粒度混入なしで、評価前draftのIssue起票は0件、tracker投影は`confirmed/pass/readiness complete`だけに限定する。
   182→- `criteria:OUT2`: 同一入力を二回実行しても`binding=beads`はbd issue/blocks edge、`binding=github`はIssue/Project item、`binding=none`はlocal nodeを各一組だけ維持する。
   183→- `criteria:OUT3`: `--dry-run`はlocal/Beads/GitHub/Projects write 0件である。
   184→- `criteria:OUT4`: `mode=both+auto`、`github+local_only`、`beads+Issue publication`の各authority衝突をfail-closedにし、外部write 0件にする。
   185→- `criteria:OUT5`: local batch成功後の外部失敗は対象operationだけを`pending_retry`から冪等再実行する。
   186→- `criteria:OUT6`: 同一ready featureの自動起動を重ねても`P01..P13 exact 13`は一組だけで、全taskの`parent_feature`と`feature_package_id`が一致する。
   187→- `criteria:OUT7`: 自動経路と手動/system-dev-plan経路は同一parent featureへ収束し二重登録0件である。
   188→
   189→## Gotchas
   190→
   191→- dev-graph は macro feature/DAG だけを作り、P01..P13 task spec 生成を再実装しない。
   192→- draft/unconfirmed/readiness incomplete の feature/task を tracker へ投影しない。

1→#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2→# /// script
     3→# name: audit-decompose-live-trial
     4→# purpose: Derive C14 live-trial evidence from repository state, preview data, and real dry-run adapter receipts.
     5→# inputs: ["snapshot|audit plus explicit repository, preview, scenario, plugin, and output paths"]
     6→# outputs: ["JSON state snapshot or audit report"]
     7→# requires-python = ">=3.10"
     8→# dependencies: []
     9→# contexts: [A, B, C, E]
    10→# network: false
    11→# write-scope: the explicit --output path only
    12→# ///
    13→"""C14 decompose live-trial の決定論的な監査ヘルパー。
    14→
    15→このヘルパーは被験 skill の代わりに preview を生成しない。skill 実行前の管理対象状態を
    16→snapshot し、skill が生成した一つの preview と、実 adapter の dry-run receipt だけから
    17→受け入れ証拠を導出する。試験中に監査コードを即席生成して期待値を自己申告することを防ぐ。
    18→"""
    19→
    20→from __future__ import annotations
    21→
    22→import argparse
    23→import copy
    24→import hashlib
    25→import json
    26→import os
    27→import subprocess
    28→from pathlib import Path
    29→from typing import Any
    30→
    31→SCENARIO_ID = "C14-OUT1-positive-macro-decomposition"
    32→BINDINGS = ("none", "beads", "github")
    33→
    34→
    35→class AuditError(RuntimeError):
    36→    """監査入力または安全条件の違反。"""
    37→
    38→
    39→def _load_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    40→    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    41→    if not isinstance(value, dict):
    42→        raise AuditError(f"JSON object required: {path}")
    43→    return value
    44→
    45→
    46→def _write_object(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    47→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    48→    path.write_text(
    49→        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
    50→        encoding="utf-8",
    51→    )
    52→
    53→
    54→def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    55→    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    56→    with path.open("rb") as stream:
    57→        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(65536), b""):
    58→            digest.update(block)
    59→    return digest.hexdigest()
    60→
    61→
    62→def _helper_identity() -> dict[str, Any]:
    63→    helper = Path(__file__).resolve()
    64→    completed = subprocess.run(
    65→        ["git", "-C", str(helper.parent), "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
    66→        text=True,
    67→        capture_output=True,
    68→        check=False,
    69→    )
    70→    if completed.returncode != os.EX_OK:
    71→        raise AuditError(f"cannot resolve helper source repository: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    72→    source_root = Path(completed.stdout.strip()).resolve(strict=True)
    73→    relative = helper.relative_to(source_root).as_posix()
    74→    staged = subprocess.run(
    75→        ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "ls-files", "--stage", "--", relative],
    76→        text=True,
    77→        capture_output=True,
    78→        check=False,
    79→    )
    80→    fields = staged.stdout.strip().split()
    81→    index_blob = fields[1] if staged.returncode == os.EX_OK and len(fields) >= 4 else None
    82→    current_blob = subprocess.run(
    83→        ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "hash-object", "--", relative],
    84→        text=True,
    85→        capture_output=True,
    86→        check=False,
    87→    )
    88→    worktree_blob = current_blob.stdout.strip() if current_blob.returncode == os.EX_OK else None
    89→    return {
    90→        "path": relative,
    91→        "sha256": _sha256(helper),
    92→        "tracked_in_index": index_blob is not None,
    93→        "index_blob": index_blob,
    94→        "worktree_blob": worktree_blob,
    95→        "index_matches_worktree": index_blob is not None and index_blob == worktree_blob,
    96→    }
    97→
    98→
    99→def _run_json(argv: list[str], *, stdin: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
   100→    completed = subprocess.run(
   101→        argv,
   102→        input=stdin,
   103→        text=True,
   104→        capture_output=True,
   105→        check=False,
   106→    )
   107→    try:
   108→        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
   109→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
   110→        detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout).strip()
   111→        raise AuditError(f"command returned invalid JSON ({completed.returncode}): {detail}") from exc
   112→    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   113→        raise AuditError(f"command JSON must be an object: {' '.join(argv)}")
   114→    return {
   115→        "argv": argv,
   116→        "returncode": completed.returncode,
   117→        "payload": payload,
   118→        "stderr": completed.stderr.strip(),
   119→    }
   120→
   121→
   122→def _git_status(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
   123→    completed = subprocess.run(
   124→        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"],
   125→        text=True,
   126→        capture_output=True,
   127→        check=False,
   128→    )
   129→    if completed.returncode != os.EX_OK:
   130→        raise AuditError(f"git status failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
   131→    entries: list[dict[str, str]] = []
   132→    chunks = completed.stdout.split("\0")
   133→    index = len(chunks[:0])
   134→    while index < len(chunks):
   135→        chunk = chunks[index]
   136→        index += len(chunks[index : index + 1])
   137→        if not chunk:
   138→            continue
   139→        status = chunk[:2]
   140→        path = chunk[3:]
   141→        entry = {"status": status, "path": path}
   142→        if status[0] in {"R", "C"} and index < len(chunks):
   143→            entry["source_path"] = chunks[index]
   144→            index += len(chunks[index : index + 1])
   145→        entries.append(entry)
   146→    managed = [entry for entry in entries if not entry["path"].startswith("eval-log/")]
   147→    return {"all": entries, "managed": managed}
   148→
   149→
   150→def _content_inventory(repo_root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
   151→    roots = config.get("content_roots")
   152→    if not isinstance(roots, dict) or not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in roots.values()):
   153→        raise AuditError("config.content_roots must be a string map")
   154→    result: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
   155→    for logical_name, relative in sorted(roots.items()):
   156→        root = repo_root / relative
   157→        files = []
   158→        if root.is_dir():
   159→            files = [
   160→                {
   161→                    "path": path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(),
   162→                    "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
   163→                    "sha256": _sha256(path),
   164→                }
   165→                for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
   166→                if path.is_file()
   167→            ]
   168→        result[logical_name] = files
   169→    return result
   170→
   171→
   172→def capture_state(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
   173→    config_path = repo_root / ".dev-graph/config.json"
   174→    config = _load_object(config_path)
   175→    graph_relative = ((config.get("local_state") or {}).get("graph"))
   176→    if not isinstance(graph_relative, str):
   177→        raise AuditError("config.local_state.graph must be a string")
   178→    graph_path = repo_root / graph_relative
   179→    graph = _load_object(graph_path)
   180→    nodes = graph.get("nodes")
   181→    if not isinstance(nodes, list):
   182→        raise AuditError("graph.nodes must be an array")
   183→    return {
   184→        "repo_root": str(repo_root),
   185→        "audit_implementation": _helper_identity(),
   186→        "config": {"path": config_path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(), "sha256": _sha256(config_path)},
   187→        "graph": {
   188→            "path": graph_path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(),
   189→            "sha256": _sha256(graph_path),
   190→            "revision": graph.get("graph_revision"),

   198→def _graph_measurements(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], threshold: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   199→    features = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "feature"]
   200→    architectures = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "architecture"]
   201→    tasks = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "task"]
   202→    ids = {
   203→        node.get("graph_node_id")
   204→        for node in nodes
   205→        if isinstance(node.get("graph_node_id"), str)
   206→    }
   207→    if len(ids) != len(nodes):
   208→        raise AuditError("preview nodes require unique string graph_node_id values")
   209→
   210→    dependencies = {
   211→        node["graph_node_id"]: [
   212→            dependency
   213→            for dependency in node.get("depends_on", [])
   214→            if dependency in ids
   215→        ]
   216→        for node in nodes
   217→    }
   218→    visiting: set[str] = set()
   219→    visited: set[str] = set()
   220→    cyclic = False
   221→
   222→    def visit(node_id: str) -> None:
   223→        nonlocal cyclic
   224→        if node_id in visiting:
   225→            cyclic = True
   226→            return
   227→        if node_id in visited:
   228→            return
   229→        visiting.add(node_id)
   230→        for dependency in dependencies[node_id]:
   231→            visit(dependency)
   232→        visiting.remove(node_id)
   233→        visited.add(node_id)
   234→
   235→    for node_id in dependencies:
   236→        visit(node_id)
   237→
   238→    feature_ids = {node["graph_node_id"] for node in features}
   239→    fan_out = {
   240→        node["graph_node_id"]: len(
   241→            [dependency for dependency in node.get("depends_on", []) if dependency in feature_ids]
   242→        )
   243→        for node in features
   244→    }
   245→    measured = max(fan_out.values()) if fan_out else None
   246→    maximum = threshold.get("max_value")
   247→    threshold_pass = (
   248→        isinstance(measured, int)
   249→        and isinstance(maximum, int)
   250→        and measured <= maximum
   251→    )
   252→    return {
   253→        "produced_node_count": len(nodes),
   254→        "feature_count": len(features),
   255→        "architecture_count": len(architectures),
   256→        "task_count": len(tasks),
   257→        "acyclic": not cyclic,
   258→        "metric": threshold.get("metric"),
   259→        "per_feature": fan_out,
   260→        "measured_max": measured,
   261→        "declared_max": maximum,
   262→        "threshold_pass": threshold_pass,
   263→    }

   388→def _state_comparison(before: dict[str, Any], after: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

   407→def audit(
   408→    *,
   409→    repo_root: Path,
   410→    preview_path: Path,
   411→    scenario_path: Path,
   412→    pre_state_path: Path,

   415→    preview = _load_object(preview_path)
   416→    nodes = preview.get("nodes")

   419→    scenarios = _load_object(scenario_path).get("scenarios")
   420→    if not isinstance(scenarios, list):
   421→        raise AuditError("scenario file requires scenarios[]")
   422→    scenario = next(
   423→        (
   424→            item
   425→            for item in scenarios
   426→            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("scenario_id") == SCENARIO_ID
   427→        ),
   428→        None,
   429→    )
   430→    if not isinstance(scenario, dict):
   431→        raise AuditError(f"scenario not found: {SCENARIO_ID}")
   432→    threshold = scenario.get("declared_granularity_threshold")
   433→    if not isinstance(threshold, dict):

   435→
   436→    features = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "feature"]
   437→    graph = _graph_measurements(nodes, threshold)
   438→    publication = _publication_measurements(features)
   439→    pre_state = _load_object(pre_state_path)
   440→    local = _state_comparison(pre_state, capture_state(repo_root))
   441→    helper = _helper_identity()
   442→    helper_pre = pre_state.get("audit_implementation")
   443→    helper_provenance_valid = (
   444→        isinstance(helper_pre, dict)
   445→        and helper_pre.get("sha256") == helper["sha256"]
   446→        and helper["tracked_in_index"]
   447→        and helper["index_matches_worktree"]
   448→    )
   449→    adapters = _adapter_receipts(repo_root, plugin_root, features[0])
   450→    adapter_suppression = {
   451→        name: _suppression_from(receipt)
   452→        for name, receipt in adapters.items()
   453→    }
   454→    schema = _run_json(
   455→        [

   458→            "--graph",
   459→            "-",
   460→            "--repo-root",

   462→        ],
   463→        stdin=json.dumps(preview, ensure_ascii=False),
   464→    )

   466→    if not isinstance(violations, list):
   467→        raise AuditError("schema receipt requires violations[]")
   468→    structural_violations = [
   469→        item

   472→    ]
   473→
   474→    suppression = {"local": local["mutation_suppressed"], **adapter_suppression}
   475→    write_counts = {

   478→    }

   481→        for result in publication["draft_candidates"].values()
   482→    )

   489→        not bool(graph["task_count"]),
   490→        draft_empty,

   492→        all(suppression.values()),
   493→        not structural_violations,
   494→        helper_provenance_valid,
   495→    ])
   496→    return {
   497→        "scenario_id": SCENARIO_ID,
   498→        "preview": str(preview_path),
   499→        "audit_implementation": {
   500→            **helper,
   501→            "same_as_pre_state": (
   502→                isinstance(helper_pre, dict)
   503→                and helper_pre.get("sha256") == helper["sha256"]
   504→            ),
   505→            "provenance_valid": helper_provenance_valid,
   506→        },
   507→        "graph": graph,

   512→        "derived_write_counts": write_counts,
   513→        "schema_validation": {

   537→    args = parser.parse_args()

### 2. REQUIRED EVAL-LOG FILES (3 files must be created)

Based on the latest fixture (decompose-wt2-v12r3), the eval-log directory must contain exactly 3 files:

#### A. `run-dev-graph-decompose-goal-spec.json`

- `original_goal`: String describing the macro-level "want" (large feature/system goal)

- `skill`: Must be "run-dev-graph-decompose"

**Hash Generation:** `sha256(goal_string).hexdigest()` in Python

---

#### B. `run-dev-graph-decompose-progress.json`
**Purpose:** Tracks checklist status for goal-seek loop iterations

**Format (from v12r3, initial state - all pending):**
```json
{
  "skill": "run-dev-graph-decompose",
  "scenario_id": "C14-OUT1-positive-macro-decomposition",
  "checklist": [
    {
      "id": "macro_dag_valid",

      "description": "各 ready feature package が P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、13-node DAG を満たす",
      "status": "pending",
      "evidence": null
    },
    {
      "id": "c02_all_or_none",
      "description": "C02 local commit が all-or-none で、自動/手動経路の重複 node が0件である",
      "status": "pending",

    },
    {
      "id": "binding_projection",
      "description": "beads/github/none の各 task が単一 projection authority と linkage を持つ",
      "status": "pending",

```

**Checklist Items (6 total):**
1. **macro_dag_valid**: DAG acyclic, no task contamination (task_granularity_contamination=false), features+architecture nodes only
2. **draft_publication_zero**: No tracker publication for draft/unconfirmed/evaluation-non-pass/readiness-non-complete nodes
3. **ready_package_exact_13**: Each ready feature package is P01..P13 exact 13 tasks with shared parent_feature and valid 13-node DAG
4. **c02_all_or_none**: C02 local commit is all-or-none, no duplicate nodes from auto/manual paths
5. **binding_projection**: Each task has single projection authority (beads/github/none) with matching linkage
6. **dry_run_write_zero**: --dry-run produces 0 writes to local files, Beads, GitHub, Projects (stdin path used for validation)

#### C. `run-dev-graph-decompose-intermediate.jsonl`
**Purpose:** Append-only log of goal-seek loop iterations with drift tracking

**Format (from v12r3, initial entry - newline-delimited JSON):**
```jsonl
{"original_goal":"ユーザー登録・ログインと、ログイン後のダッシュボードを持つ小規模 Web アプリを作りたい","original_goal_hash":"ef9c0579287c518d38e78af5fa1ab1c024f357aa5f9f0afa0f0ed6727e150d6b","current_goal_snapshot":"Skill実行前: macro decompose のための goal-seek 配線を準備し、pre-state snapshot を取得する","delta_from_original":"なし - 初回エントリ","merged_directive_for_next":"fixture repo に対して run-dev-graph-decompose を --dry-run --binding none で実行し、preview graph を保存する","drift_signal":"none"}
```

**Required Fields (per entry):**
- `original_goal`: Must match goal-spec.json original_goal
- `original_goal_hash`: Must match goal-spec.json original_goal_hash
- `current_goal_snapshot`: Current state description (localized per loop iteration)
- `delta_from_original`: Description of changes from original goal ("なし" if no drift)

**Validation Rules (from SKILL.md):**
- Entries are append-only
- Required keys must all be present in every entry
- original_goal must match across all entries
- original_goal_hash must match SHA256 hash of original_goal

### 3. SCENARIO REQUIREMENTS (C14-OUT1-positive-macro-decomposition)

From `live-trial-positive-scenarios.json`, the C14 OUT1 scenario defines:

**Fixture Contract:**
> A contained initialized repository holds the macro decomposition input (the want) and deliberately holds no expected feature, architecture or task node, so every produced node is attributable to the skill rather than to the fixture. At least one produced feature must remain in pre-evaluation draft so the zero-issue-publication rule is exercised rather than holding vacuously. The run must additionally promote at least one produced feature to confirmed with evaluation-pass while its implementation_readiness stays incomplete, so the publication-candidate gate has to evaluate readiness and exclude it.

**Key Constraints:**
1. **Initial Graph Empty**: `.dev-graph/state/graph.json` must have `{"graph_revision": 0, "nodes": []}` (CONFIRMED - v12r4 already set up correctly)
2. **No Pre-seeded Nodes**: No feature, architecture, or task nodes in initial graph
3. **Content Roots Empty**: All content root directories must contain only `.gitkeep` (CONFIRMED)
4. **Goal = The Want**: The original_goal field stores the natural language want/intention string

**Declared Granularity Threshold:**
```json
{
  "metric": "max_inter_feature_depends_on_per_feature",
  "max_value": 3,
  "rationale": "マクロ分解が生む feature は通常 2-6 件で、ある feature が 4 件以上の兄弟へ依存する状態は「兄弟のほぼ全部に依存している」ことを意味し、feature 境界の切り方が task 粒度まで細かくなった兆候。現行 fixture の正常系は最大 fan-out 1 (feat-dashboard-001 -> feat-user-auth-001 の 1 本のみ) なので 3 なら正常系が余裕で収まり、かつ過剰分解は確実に超える。"
}
```

goal_seek:

Contains snapshot of repository state BEFORE skill execution:

# run-dev-graph-decompose

## Purpose & Output Contract

- 入力: 大きな want、feature 粒度/依存方針、C24/C11 検証済み graph context、任意の system-dev-planner package。
- 出力: feature/architecture/機能間 DAG の macro report、ready feature ごとの exact-13 package receipt、binding 別 publication report。
- 完了条件: macro DAG に phase-task 混入0、ready package が P01..P13 exact-set、自動/手動経路の二重登録0、dry-run write 0 である。

## Hard boundary

dev-graph はマクロ層: purpose/goal/scope/acceptance を持つ feature、共有 architecture node、feature 間 `depends_on` を所有する。system-dev-planner はミクロ層: **1 feature から P01..P13 の13 task specs/DAG/package** を所有する。本 skill が phase task を独自生成してはならない。

## Macro flow

1. 大きな want、feature 粒度、依存推定方針、dry-run を確認する。
2. want を feature 候補と architecture context に分解し、各 feature に `purpose/goal/scope_in/scope_out/acceptance/architecture_refs` を付ける。循環と実装粒度の task 混入を独立 auditor で拒否する。
3. C02 preview/atomic writer で macro graph を登録する。draft/unconfirmed/readiness incomplete は tracker 投影しない。
4. feature 間依存が満たされた ready feature ごとに `run-system-dev-plan` を Skill 呼出しする。`--manual-plan`/`/system-dev-plan` 結果も同じ package gate へ入れる。
5. P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、13-node DAG、source digest を検証し、C02 `register-package` へ渡す。`graph_node_id+source_digest` で自動/手動の二重登録を防ぐ。
6. `beads` は C28 create/dep-add、`github` は C12 Issue/任意 Projects、`none` は local only。mode=both+auto、github+local_only、beads+GitHub Issue mutation は fail-closed。

local commit 後の外部失敗は rollback せず node/operation 単位 pending_retry。`--dry-run` は local/Beads/GitHub write 0。出力は macro report、per-feature package receipt、publication report。

`--dry-run` の preview graph を C11 検証するときは、管理対象 repo へ一時ファイルを書かず **stdin 経路**を使う。`--graph FILE` は `contained(graph, repo_root)` を要求するため、preview を file 経由で検証すると必ず write が発生し `--dry-run write 0` 契約を破る (書いて直後に unlink しても write count は0にならない)。

```bash
printf '%s' "$PREVIEW_GRAPH_JSON" \
  | python3 "$DEV_GRAPH_PLUGIN/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py" --graph - --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT"
```

## ゴールシーク実行

### ゴール (Goal)

自然文の「やりたいこと(大)」からfeatureノード群+architectureノード+機能間depends_onを生成するマクロ分解を行い、ready featureごとにsystem-dev-planner(ミクロ層)を自動起動または手動`/system-dev-plan`実行結果を受理してpromoted typed task群をparent_feature付きでC02へatomic登録し、binding=beadsはC28へissue/依存edge、binding=githubはC12へIssue/任意Projects、binding=noneはローカルのみへ冪等投影した状態になっている

### 目的・背景 (Why)

マクロ (feature/architecture/機能間依存の保持+実行オーケストレーション) とミクロ (1 feature→13タスク仕様書) の責務混線を避けるため、C14は自然文のwantをfeature+architecture+機能間depends_onへ分解するところまでを担い、feature単位の細タスク仕様書生成はexternal plugin system-dev-planner (external_contract_ref: plugin-plans/system-dev-planner/handoff-run-plugin-dev-plan.json) へ委譲する。ready feature (機能間depends_on充足) ごとに [自動] run-system-dev-planをSkill呼出しでpurpose/goal/scope_in/scope_out/acceptance/architecture_refsを入力文脈として渡し、[手動] 人間の`/system-dev-plan`実行結果も同じ入口として受理する。両経路が返すpromoted typed taskはgraph_node_id+source_digestを冪等キーにC02単一writer経由でparent_feature=当該featureとしてatomic登録し、二重登録を防ぐ。既存の「自然文とpromoted system taskの入口一本化」責務は維持し、tracker_binding_intentはC02がrepo-configと照合して解決し、mode=bothのautoは拒否する。beadsはC28 create/dep-add、githubはC12 Issue/Projects、noneはlocal graphだけへ投影する。GitHub binding+local_onlyは未管理taskを生むため拒否する

### 完了チェックリスト

- [ ] macro result が feature/architecture/機能間 depends_on だけを持ち循環と phase-task 混入が0件である
- [ ] draft/unconfirmed/evaluation非pass/readiness非complete の tracker publication が0件である
- [ ] 各 ready feature package が P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、13-node DAG を満たす
- [ ] C02 local commit が all-or-none で、自動/手動経路の重複 node が0件である
- [ ] beads/github/none の各 task が単一 projection authority と linkage を持つ
- [ ] `--dry-run` の local/Beads/GitHub/Projects write count が0である (preview 検証は `--graph -` の stdin 経路を使い、一時ファイルの作成→削除も write として数える)

### ゴールシークループ

frontmatter の `goal_seek.engine: inline` / `fork: subagent` / `max_loops: 5` を実行契約とする。固定手順は使わず、未達 checklist と担当 `prompts/*.md` からその周回の操作を都度生成する。各周回で inner criterion を検証し、完了後は outer criterion の live trial/content review を最大 `feedback_contract.max_iterations=3` 周で評価する。

### ゴールシーク配線

- 開始時に C24 `resolve-repo-context.py --mode write` の JSON receipt を得て、`repo_root` が `content_roots.repository` の realpath と一致する場合だけ `DEV_GRAPH_ROOT=<receipt.repo_root>` に固定する。cwd から再解決しない。
- 元のゴールを `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-goal-spec.json` へ、各 checklist の status/evidence を `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-progress.json` へ記録する。
- 未達 responsibility を担当する `prompts/<R-id>.md` を読み、`Agent` で分離 context に fork する。ユーザー判断が必要な境界だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。
- 各周回末に `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-intermediate.jsonl` へ `original_goal`、`original_goal_hash`、`current_goal_snapshot`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を append-only で記録する。次周回は直前の `merged_directive_for_next` を必須入力にする。
- 5周到達時に未達が残れば完了扱いせず、progress と blocker を親へ handoff する。全 checklist と `feedback_contract.criteria` が PASS のときだけ完了する。

### ゴールシーク検証

各周回後に次の検査を実行し、中間成果物の欠落・goal drift・hash 不一致を fail-closed にする。

```bash
python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-decompose-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
```

## Criteria acceptance

- `criteria:IN1`: `validate-graph-schema.py`で生成nodeを検証し必須キー欠落が0件である。
- `criteria:OUT1`: `feature+architecture` DAGは循環なし・task粒度混入なしで、評価前draftのIssue起票は0件、tracker投影は`confirmed/pass/readiness complete`だけに限定する。
- `criteria:OUT2`: 同一入力を二回実行しても`binding=beads`はbd issue/blocks edge、`binding=github`はIssue/Project item、`binding=none`はlocal nodeを各一組だけ維持する。
- `criteria:OUT3`: `--dry-run`はlocal/Beads/GitHub/Projects write 0件である。
- `criteria:OUT4`: `mode=both+auto`、`github+local_only`、`beads+Issue publication`の各authority衝突をfail-closedにし、外部write 0件にする。
- `criteria:OUT5`: local batch成功後の外部失敗は対象operationだけを`pending_retry`から冪等再実行する。
- `criteria:OUT6`: 同一ready featureの自動起動を重ねても`P01..P13 exact 13`は一組だけで、全taskの`parent_feature`と`feature_package_id`が一致する。
- `criteria:OUT7`: 自動経路と手動/system-dev-plan経路は同一parent featureへ収束し二重登録0件である。

## Gotchas

- dev-graph は macro feature/DAG だけを作り、P01..P13 task spec 生成を再実装しない。
- draft/unconfirmed/readiness incomplete の feature/task を tracker へ投影しない。
- 自動と手動の planner 結果を別 gate にせず、同じ `graph_node_id+source_digest` の冪等キーへ収束させる。
- local commit 後の外部失敗で macro graph を rollback せず、失敗 operation だけを `pending_retry` に残す。
- `mode=both+auto`、`github+local_only`、`beads+Issue mutation` は authority 衝突として fail-closed にする。
- `--dry-run` の preview 検証で管理対象 repo へ一時ファイルを書かない。`--graph -` の stdin 経路を使う。書いて直後に unlink しても write count は0にならず、receipt の `write_counts.local_files` を0と自己申告すると過少報告になる (2026-07-21 live-trial r13 の実例)。

## Layer 2: ドメイン層

- 自然文want、feature粒度方針、依存根拠、dry-run。

- purpose/goal/scope/acceptanceを保ったmacro brief。

### 責務境界

- P01..P13 task specを作らず保存先を質問せず過分解しない。

### 受入条件

- 各feature候補が独立価値/二値acceptance/依存根拠を持つ。

## Layer 3: インフラ層

- 使用資産: AskUserQuestionとRead。
- path は caller repository context または skill-relative reference から解決し、環境固有の絶対 path を成果物へ保存しない。

## Layer 4: 共通ポリシー層

- 入力契約、authority、containment、schema のいずれかが未達なら fail-closed とし、部分成功を PASS にしない。
- secret と認証情報を prompt 出力、graph、receipt に埋め込まない。
- 同一入力と同一 revision/digest では同じ decision と output shape を返す。

## Layer 5: エージェント層 (l5-contract v2.0.0)

### 5.1 担当 agent

- `run-dev-graph-decompose/R1-elicit`。重い判断または独立検証は `Agent` で分離 context に fork する。

### 5.2 ゴール定義

- 目的: 自然文の「やりたいこと(大)」とマクロ分解の粒度基準 (feature単位)・機能間依存推定方針、および --dry-run 指定の有無をヒアリングして確定する
- 背景: この責務を隣接 responsibility から分離し、入力・出力・authority を一意にする。
- 達成ゴール: purpose/goal/scope/acceptanceを保ったmacro briefが生成され、受入条件を満たした状態になっている。

### 5.3 完了チェックリスト (ゴール到達の停止条件)

- [ ] 宣言した入力が全て検証済みである
- [ ] 出力が宣言した shape と authority を満たす
- [ ] 責務境界に反する read/write/delegation が0件である
- [ ] 各feature候補が独立価値/二値acceptance/依存根拠を持つ

### 5.4 実行方式

- 固定手順を持たない。未達 checklist を評価し、操作を都度立案・実行・検証する。各周回末に `original_goal`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を追記し、最大5周で未達なら上位 skill へ fail-closed で返す。

## Layer 6: オーケストレーション層

- R2へbriefを渡す。
- 前段 receipt/digest と後段 input digest を一致させ、stale handoff を拒否する。

## Layer 7: UserInput

- 不足情報が実行結果を変える場合だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。repo policy で決まる値、保存先、secret、node ID は質問しない。
- ユーザー提示は日本語、schema key/CLI parameter は原語を保つ。

## 出力指示

Layer 2 の入力・出力・責務境界・受入条件を正本としてこの単一責務だけを実行し、思考過程を出力せず、artifact/receipt、検証結果、未達 blocker だけを返す。

    51→        "object": isinstance(value, dict),
    52→        "array": isinstance(value, list),
    53→        "string": isinstance(value, str),
    54→        "boolean": isinstance(value, bool),
    55→        "integer": isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool),
    56→        "number": isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool),
    57→    }.get(expected, True)
    58→
    59→
    60→def _format_ok(value: str, expected: str) -> bool:
    61→    try:
    62→        if expected == "date":
    63→            date.fromisoformat(value)
    64→        elif expected == "date-time":
    65→            datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    66→        elif expected == "uri":
    67→            return bool(urlsplit(value).scheme)
    68→    except ValueError:
    69→        return False
    70→    return True
    71→
    72→
    73→def _schema_fallback(value: Any, schema: Any, root: dict[str, Any], path: str = "$") -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    74→    """Deterministic Draft 2020-12 subset used if jsonschema is unavailable."""
    75→    if schema is True:
    76→        return []
    77→    if schema is False or not isinstance(schema, dict):
    78→        return [(path, "value is forbidden" if schema is False else "invalid schema object")]
    79→    findings: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    80→    reference = schema.get("$ref")
    81→    if isinstance(reference, str):
    82→        if not reference.startswith("#/"):
    83→            return [(path, f"external schema reference is forbidden: {reference}")]
    84→        target: Any = root
    85→        try:
    86→            for part in reference[2:].split("/"):
    87→                target = target[part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")]
    88→        except (KeyError, TypeError):
    89→            return [(path, f"unresolved schema reference: {reference}")]
    90→        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, target, root, path))
    91→    for child in schema.get("allOf", []):
    92→        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, child, root, path))
    93→    if "if" in schema and not _schema_fallback(value, schema["if"], root, path) and "then" in schema:
    94→        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, schema["then"], root, path))
    95→    expected = schema.get("type")
    96→    if expected is not None:
    97→        choices = expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected]
    98→        if not any(_is_type(value, choice) for choice in choices):
    99→            return findings + [(path, f"expected type {choices}, got {type(value).__name__}")]
   100→    if "const" in schema and value != schema["const"]:
   101→        findings.append((path, f"expected const {schema['const']!r}"))
   102→    if "enum" in schema and value not in schema["enum"]:
   103→        findings.append((path, f"not in enum {schema['enum']!r}"))
   104→    if isinstance(value, str):
   105→        if len(value) < schema.get("minLength", 0):
   106→            findings.append((path, "string is shorter than minLength"))
   107→        if "pattern" in schema and re.search(schema["pattern"], value) is None:
   108→            findings.append((path, f"does not match {schema['pattern']}"))
   109→        if "format" in schema and not _format_ok(value, schema["format"]):
   110→            findings.append((path, f"invalid {schema['format']} format"))
   111→    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
   112→        if "minimum" in schema and value < schema["minimum"]:
   113→            findings.append((path, "below minimum"))
   114→        if "maximum" in schema and value > schema["maximum"]:
   115→            findings.append((path, "above maximum"))
   116→    if isinstance(value, list):
   117→        if len(value) < schema.get("minItems", 0):
   118→            findings.append((path, "too few items"))
   119→        if "maxItems" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]:
   120→            findings.append((path, "too many items"))
   121→        if schema.get("uniqueItems"):
   122→            packed = [json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) for item in value]
   123→            if len(packed) != len(set(packed)):
   124→                findings.append((path, "items are not unique"))
   125→        items = schema.get("items")
   126→        if isinstance(items, dict):
   127→            for index, item in enumerate(value):
   128→                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(item, items, root, f"{path}[{index}]"))
   129→        if "contains" in schema and not any(not _schema_fallback(item, schema["contains"], root, path) for item in value):
   130→            findings.append((path, "contains constraint is not satisfied"))
   131→    if isinstance(value, dict):
   132→        for key in schema.get("required", []):
   133→            if key not in value:
   134→                findings.append((path, f"missing required property {key}"))
   135→        properties = schema.get("properties", {})
   136→        for key, child in properties.items():
   137→            if key in value:
   138→                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value[key], child, root, f"{path}.{key}"))
   139→        additional = schema.get("additionalProperties", True)
   140→        unknown = sorted(set(value) - set(properties))
   141→        if additional is False and unknown:
   142→            findings.append((path, f"unknown properties {unknown}"))
   143→        elif isinstance(additional, dict):
   144→            for key in unknown:
   145→                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value[key], additional, root, f"{path}.{key}"))
   146→    return findings
   147→
   148→
   149→def schema_findings(node: dict[str, Any], schema: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
   150→    node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
   151→    try:
   152→        from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker  # type: ignore
   153→    except ImportError:
   154→        raw = _schema_fallback(node, schema, schema)
   155→    else:
   156→        try:
   157→            Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
   158→        except Exception as exc:
   159→            raise ContractError(f"invalid canonical graph schema {SCHEMA_PATH}: {exc}") from exc
   160→        validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
   161→        errors = sorted(
   162→            validator.iter_errors(node),
   163→            key=lambda err: (tuple(str(part) for part in err.absolute_path), err.message),
   164→        )
   165→        raw = [
   166→            ("$" + "".join(f"[{part}]" if isinstance(part, int) else f".{part}" for part in error.absolute_path), error.message)
   167→            for error in errors
   168→        ]
   169→    return [
   170→        {"node": node_id, "code": "schema_violation", "detail": f"{path}: {detail}"}
   171→        for path, detail in raw
   172→    ]
   173→
   174→
   175→def _scalar(raw: str) -> Any:
   176→    value = raw.strip()
   177→    try:
   178→        return json.loads(value)
   179→    except json.JSONDecodeError:
   180→        if (value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'")) or (value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"')):
   181→            return value[1:-1]
   182→        return value
   183→
   184→
   185→def frontmatter_of(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
   186→    try:
   187→        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
   188→    except OSError as exc:
   189→        raise ContractError(f"cannot read artifact {path}: {exc}") from exc
   190→    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != "---":
   191→        raise ContractError(f"artifact has no YAML frontmatter: {path}")
   192→    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
   193→    for line in lines[1:]:
   194→        if line.strip() == "---":
   195→            return result
   196→        match = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*):(?:\s*(.*))?$", line)
   197→        if match:
   198→            result[match.group(1)] = _scalar(match.group(2) or "")
   199→    raise ContractError(f"artifact frontmatter is not terminated: {path}")
   200→
   201→
   202→def _repo_root_for(graph: Path, explicit: str | None) -> Path:
   203→    if explicit:
   204→        root = Path(explicit).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
   205→        contained(graph, root)
   206→        return root
   207→    resolved = graph.resolve(strict=True)
   208→    for parent in resolved.parents:
   209→        if parent.name == ".dev-graph":
   210→            return parent.parent
   211→    raise ContractError("--repo-root is required when --graph is outside the canonical .dev-graph tree")
   212→
   213→
   214→def artifact_findings(
   215→    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], repo_root: Path | None, template_contract: dict[str, Any]
   216→) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
   217→    findings: list[dict[str, str]] = []
   218→    required_frontmatter = set((template_contract.get("common_frontmatter") or {}).get("required") or [])
   219→    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
   220→        node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
   221→        kind = node.get("artifact_kind", node.get("kind"))
   222→        raw_path = node.get("file_path")
   223→        if kind in ROOT_BY_KIND and isinstance(raw_path, str):
   224→            logical = PurePosixPath(raw_path)
   225→            if logical.is_absolute() or ".." in logical.parts or not logical.parts or logical.parts[0] != ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]:
   226→                findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "path_parity_error", "detail": f"{kind} must be under {ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]}/"})
   227→                continue
   228→        if repo_root is None or not isinstance(raw_path, str):
   229→            continue
   230→        candidate = repo_root / raw_path
   231→        try:
   232→            # Missing canonical artifacts are readiness gaps, not containment
   233→            # failures.  Resolve without requiring existence, then let the
   234→            # is_file check below classify the missing artifact explicitly.
   235→            artifact = contained(candidate, repo_root, must_exist=False)
   236→        except (ContractError, OSError) as exc:
   237→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "artifact_path_invalid", "detail": str(exc)})
   238→            continue
   239→        if not artifact.is_file():
   240→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "artifact_missing", "detail": raw_path})
   241→            continue
   242→        try:
   243→            frontmatter = frontmatter_of(artifact)
   244→        except ContractError as exc:
   245→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_invalid", "detail": str(exc)})
   246→            continue
   247→        for key in sorted(required_frontmatter - set(frontmatter)):
   248→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_missing", "detail": key})
   249→        for key in ("graph_node_id", "artifact_kind", "file_path", "template_id", "template_version"):
   250→            if key in node and frontmatter.get(key) != node.get(key):
   251→                findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_parity_error", "detail": key})
   252→    return findings
   253→
   254→
   255→def domain_findings(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
   256→    findings: list[dict[str, str]] = []
   257→    ids: list[str] = []
   258→    by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   259→    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
   260→        node_id = node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id")
   261→        loc = str(node_id or f"nodes[{index}]")
   262→        if not isinstance(node_id, str) or not node_id:
   263→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "missing_id", "detail": "graph_node_id required"})
   264→            continue
   265→        ids.append(node_id)
   266→        by_id[node_id] = node
   267→        kind = node.get("artifact_kind", node.get("kind"))
   268→        if kind is not None and kind not in ROOT_BY_KIND:
   269→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_kind", "detail": str(kind)})
   270→        if node.get("status") not in {"draft", "active", "blocked", "done", "closed", "tombstoned"}:
   271→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_status", "detail": str(node.get("status"))})
   272→        dependencies = node.get("depends_on", [])
   273→        if not isinstance(dependencies, list) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in dependencies):
   274→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_dependencies", "detail": "depends_on must be string[]"})
   275→        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "beads" and (node.get("github_publication") or {}).get("mode") != "local_only":
   276→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "beads_publication", "detail": "beads requires local_only"})
   277→        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "github" and node.get("beads_linkage") is not None:
   278→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "binding_collision", "detail": "github cannot have beads_linkage"})
   279→        if node.get("status") == "active":
   280→            readiness = (node.get("implementation_readiness") or {}).get("status")
   281→            if node.get("confirmation_status") != "confirmed" or node.get("evaluation_status") != "pass" or readiness != "complete":
   282→                findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "active_not_ready", "detail": "active requires confirmed/pass/complete"})
   283→        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "repo-config-default":
   284→            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "unresolved_tracker_binding", "detail": "durable graph cannot retain repo-config-default"})
   285→    for duplicate, count in Counter(ids).items():
   286→        if count > 1:
   287→            findings.append({"node": duplicate, "code": "duplicate_id", "detail": str(count)})
   288→    reference_fields = ("depends_on", "related_nodes", "architecture_refs")
   289→    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
   290→        node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
   291→        for field in reference_fields:
   292→            for reference in node.get(field, []) if isinstance(node.get(field, []), list) else []:
   293→                if reference not in by_id:
   294→                    code = "dangling_dependency" if field == "depends_on" else "dangling_reference"
   295→                    findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": code, "detail": f"{field}:{reference}"})
   296→        parent = node.get("parent_feature")
   297→        if isinstance(parent, str) and parent not in by_id:
   298→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "dangling_reference", "detail": f"parent_feature:{parent}"})
   299→
   300→    state: dict[str, int] = {}
   301→
   302→    def visit(node_id: str) -> None:
   303→        if state.get(node_id) == 1:
   304→            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "dependency_cycle", "detail": node_id})
   305→            return
   306→        if state.get(node_id) == 2:
   307→            return
   308→        state[node_id] = 1
   309→        dependencies = by_id[node_id].get("depends_on", [])
   310→        for dependency in dependencies if isinstance(dependencies, list) else []:
   311→            if dependency in by_id:
   312→                visit(dependency)
   313→        state[node_id] = 2
   314→
   315→    for node_id in by_id:
   316→        visit(node_id)
   317→
   318→    children: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
   319→    for node in nodes:
   320→        if isinstance(node.get("parent_feature"), str):
   321→            children[node["parent_feature"]].append(node)
   322→    order = {phase: int(phase[1:]) for phase in PHASES}
   323→    for feature_id, feature in ((node_id, node) for node_id, node in by_id.items() if node.get("artifact_kind") == "feature"):
   324→        members = children.get(feature_id, [])
   325→        if members or feature.get("status") == "done":
   326→            packages = {member.get("feature_package_id") for member in members}
   327→            phases = [member.get("phase_ref") for member in members]
   328→            if packages == {None} or len(packages) != 1 or set(phases) != PHASES or len(members) != 13:
   329→                findings.append({"node": feature_id, "code": "feature_package_not_exact_13", "detail": f"count={len(members)} phases={sorted(str(value) for value in set(phases))}"})
   330→        for child in members:
   331→            current = order.get(child.get("phase_ref"), 0)
   332→            for dependency in child.get("depends_on", []):
   333→                target = by_id.get(dependency, {})
   334→                if target.get("parent_feature") == feature_id and order.get(target.get("phase_ref"), 0) >= current:
   335→                    findings.append({"node": str(child.get("graph_node_id") or child.get("id") or "?"), "code": "non_forward_phase_dependency", "detail": dependency})
   336→        if feature.get("status") == "done":
   337→            if any(member.get("status") != "done" for member in members):
   338→                findings.append({"node": feature_id, "code": "premature_feature_done", "detail": "all 13 children must be done"})
   339→            for phase in {"P07", "P10", "P11"}:
   340→                child = next((member for member in members if member.get("phase_ref") == phase), {})
   341→                if not (child.get("completion_evidence") or {}).get("evidence_refs"):
   342→                    findings.append({"node": feature_id, "code": "feature_evidence_missing", "detail": phase})
   343→    return findings
   344→
   345→
   346→def validate(
   347→    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
   348→    *, repo_root: Path | None = None, template_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
   349→) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
   350→    canonical_schema = schema or load_json(SCHEMA_PATH)
   351→    if not isinstance(canonical_schema, dict):
   352→        raise ContractError(f"canonical graph schema must be an object: {SCHEMA_PATH}")
   353→    contract = template_contract or load_json(TEMPLATE_CONTRACT_PATH)
   354→    if not isinstance(contract, dict):
   355→        raise ContractError(f"template contract must be an object: {TEMPLATE_CONTRACT_PATH}")
   356→    findings = [item for index, node in enumerate(nodes) for item in schema_findings(node, canonical_schema, index)]
   357→    findings.extend(domain_findings(nodes))
   358→    findings.extend(artifact_findings(nodes, repo_root, contract))
   359→    return sorted(findings, key=lambda item: (item["node"], item["code"], item["detail"]))
   360→
   361→
   362→def main() -> int:
   363→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   364→    parser.add_argument(
   365→        "--graph",
   366→        required=True,
   367→        help="graph JSON path、または '-' で stdin から preview graph を読む (dry-run 用)",
   368→    )
   369→    parser.add_argument("--repo-root")
   370→    args = parser.parse_args()
   371→    if args.graph == "-":
   372→        # dry-run preview 検証: 管理対象 repo へ一時ファイルを書かせないための stdin 経路。
   373→        # --graph FILE は contained(graph, root) を要求するため、preview を検証するには
   374→        # repo 内へ書くしかなく「dry-run write 0」契約と矛盾していた (C14 OUT3)。
   375→        if not args.repo_root:
   376→            raise ContractError("--repo-root is required when reading a preview graph from stdin")
   377→        repo_root = Path(args.repo_root).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
   378→        nodes = nodes_of(json.loads(sys.stdin.read()))
   379→    else:
   380→        graph = Path(args.graph).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
   381→        repo_root = _repo_root_for(graph, args.repo_root)
   382→        nodes = nodes_of(load_json(graph))
   383→    violations = validate(nodes, repo_root=repo_root)
   384→    missing = sorted({
   385→        item["detail"] for item in violations
   386→        if item["code"] in {"frontmatter_missing", "artifact_missing"}
   387→        or (item["code"] == "schema_violation" and "required property" in item["detail"])
   388→    })
   389→    dump({
   390→        "valid": not violations,
   391→        "implementation_readiness": "complete" if not violations else "incomplete",
   392→        "missing_sections": missing,
   393→        "schema": str(SCHEMA_PATH),
   394→        "violations": violations,
   395→    })
   396→    return 0 if not violations else 1
   397→
   398→
   399→if __name__ == "__main__":
   400→    try:
   401→        raise SystemExit(main())
   402→    except (ContractError, OSError) as exc:
   403→        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
   404→        raise SystemExit(2)
   405→

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# /// script
# name: audit-decompose-live-trial
# purpose: Derive C14 live-trial evidence from repository state, preview data, and real dry-run adapter receipts.
# inputs: ["snapshot|audit plus explicit repository, preview, scenario, plugin, and output paths"]
# outputs: ["JSON state snapshot or audit report"]
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies: []
# contexts: [A, B, C, E]
# network: false
# write-scope: the explicit --output path only
# ///
"""C14 decompose live-trial の決定論的な監査ヘルパー。

このヘルパーは被験 skill の代わりに preview を生成しない。skill 実行前の管理対象状態を
snapshot し、skill が生成した一つの preview と、実 adapter の dry-run receipt だけから
受け入れ証拠を導出する。試験中に監査コードを即席生成して期待値を自己申告することを防ぐ。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

SCENARIO_ID = "C14-OUT1-positive-macro-decomposition"
BINDINGS = ("none", "beads", "github")


class AuditError(RuntimeError):
    """監査入力または安全条件の違反。"""


def _load_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise AuditError(f"JSON object required: {path}")
    return value


def _write_object(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(65536), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _helper_identity() -> dict[str, Any]:
    helper = Path(__file__).resolve()
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(helper.parent), "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != os.EX_OK:
        raise AuditError(f"cannot resolve helper source repository: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    source_root = Path(completed.stdout.strip()).resolve(strict=True)
    relative = helper.relative_to(source_root).as_posix()
    staged = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "ls-files", "--stage", "--", relative],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    fields = staged.stdout.strip().split()
    index_blob = fields[1] if staged.returncode == os.EX_OK and len(fields) >= 4 else None
    current_blob = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "hash-object", "--", relative],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    worktree_blob = current_blob.stdout.strip() if current_blob.returncode == os.EX_OK else None
    return {
        "path": relative,
        "sha256": _sha256(helper),
        "tracked_in_index": index_blob is not None,
        "index_blob": index_blob,
        "worktree_blob": worktree_blob,
        "index_matches_worktree": index_blob is not None and index_blob == worktree_blob,
    }


def _run_json(argv: list[str], *, stdin: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        argv,
        input=stdin,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    try:
        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout).strip()
        raise AuditError(f"command returned invalid JSON ({completed.returncode}): {detail}") from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise AuditError(f"command JSON must be an object: {' '.join(argv)}")
    return {
        "argv": argv,
        "returncode": completed.returncode,
        "payload": payload,
        "stderr": completed.stderr.strip(),
    }


def _git_status(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != os.EX_OK:
        raise AuditError(f"git status failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    entries: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    chunks = completed.stdout.split("\0")
    index = len(chunks[:0])
    while index < len(chunks):
        chunk = chunks[index]
        index += len(chunks[index : index + 1])
        if not chunk:
            continue
        status = chunk[:2]
        path = chunk[3:]
        entry = {"status": status, "path": path}
        if status[0] in {"R", "C"} and index < len(chunks):
            entry["source_path"] = chunks[index]
            index += len(chunks[index : index + 1])
        entries.append(entry)
    managed = [entry for entry in entries if not entry["path"].startswith("eval-log/")]
    return {"all": entries, "managed": managed}


def _content_inventory(repo_root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    roots = config.get("content_roots")
    if not isinstance(roots, dict) or not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in roots.values()):
        raise AuditError("config.content_roots must be a string map")
    result: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for logical_name, relative in sorted(roots.items()):
        root = repo_root / relative
        files = []
        if root.is_dir():
            files = [
                {
                    "path": path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(),
                    "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                    "sha256": _sha256(path),
                }
                for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
                if path.is_file()
            ]
        result[logical_name] = files
    return result


def capture_state(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    config_path = repo_root / ".dev-graph/config.json"
    config = _load_object(config_path)
    graph_relative = ((config.get("local_state") or {}).get("graph"))
    if not isinstance(graph_relative, str):
        raise AuditError("config.local_state.graph must be a string")
    graph_path = repo_root / graph_relative
    graph = _load_object(graph_path)
    nodes = graph.get("nodes")
    if not isinstance(nodes, list):
        raise AuditError("graph.nodes must be an array")
    return {
        "repo_root": str(repo_root),
        "audit_implementation": _helper_identity(),
        "config": {"path": config_path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(), "sha256": _sha256(config_path)},
        "graph": {
            "path": graph_path.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix(),
            "sha256": _sha256(graph_path),
            "revision": graph.get("graph_revision"),
            "node_count": len(nodes),
        },
        "content_inventory": _content_inventory(repo_root, config),
        "git_status": _git_status(repo_root),
    }


def _graph_measurements(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], threshold: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    features = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "feature"]
    architectures = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "architecture"]
    tasks = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "task"]
    ids = {
        node.get("graph_node_id")
        for node in nodes
        if isinstance(node.get("graph_node_id"), str)
    }
    if len(ids) != len(nodes):
        raise AuditError("preview nodes require unique string graph_node_id values")

    dependencies = {
        node["graph_node_id"]: [
            dependency
            for dependency in node.get("depends_on", [])
            if dependency in ids
        ]
        for node in nodes
    }
    visiting: set[str] = set()
    visited: set[str] = set()
    cyclic = False

    def visit(node_id: str) -> None:
        nonlocal cyclic
        if node_id in visiting:
            cyclic = True
            return
        if node_id in visited:
            return
        visiting.add(node_id)
        for dependency in dependencies[node_id]:
            visit(dependency)
        visiting.remove(node_id)
        visited.add(node_id)

    for node_id in dependencies:
        visit(node_id)

    feature_ids = {node["graph_node_id"] for node in features}
    fan_out = {
        node["graph_node_id"]: len(
            [dependency for dependency in node.get("depends_on", []) if dependency in feature_ids]
        )
        for node in features
    }
    measured = max(fan_out.values()) if fan_out else None
    maximum = threshold.get("max_value")
    threshold_pass = (
        isinstance(measured, int)
        and isinstance(maximum, int)
        and measured <= maximum
    )
    return {
        "produced_node_count": len(nodes),
        "feature_count": len(features),
        "architecture_count": len(architectures),
        "task_count": len(tasks),
        "acyclic": not cyclic,
        "metric": threshold.get("metric"),
        "per_feature": fan_out,
        "measured_max": measured,
        "declared_max": maximum,
        "threshold_pass": threshold_pass,
    }


def _is_publication_candidate(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return (
        node.get("confirmation_status") == "confirmed"
        and node.get("evaluation_status") == "pass"
        and (node.get("implementation_readiness") or {}).get("status") == "complete"
    )


def _publication_measurements(features: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    draft = {
        binding: [
            node["graph_node_id"]
            for node in features
            if _is_publication_candidate(node)
        ]
        for binding in BINDINGS
    }
    if not features:
        raise AuditError("preview must contain at least one produced feature")
    probe = copy.deepcopy(features[0])
    probe["confirmation_status"] = "confirmed"
    probe["evaluation_status"] = "pass"
    readiness = probe.setdefault("implementation_readiness", {})
    if not isinstance(readiness, dict):
        raise AuditError("feature implementation_readiness must be an object")
    readiness["status"] = "incomplete"
    conditions = {
        "confirmation_confirmed": probe.get("confirmation_status") == "confirmed",
        "evaluation_pass": probe.get("evaluation_status") == "pass",
        "readiness_complete": readiness.get("status") == "complete",
    }
    return {
        "draft_candidates": {
            binding: {"ids": ids, "count": len(ids)}
            for binding, ids in draft.items()
        },
        "readiness_probe": {
            "graph_node_id": probe["graph_node_id"],
            "conditions": conditions,
            "candidate": _is_publication_candidate(probe),
            "excluded_only_by_readiness": (
                conditions["confirmation_confirmed"]
                and conditions["evaluation_pass"]
                and not conditions["readiness_complete"]
                and not _is_publication_candidate(probe)
            ),
        },
    }


def _adapter_receipts(
    repo_root: Path,
    plugin_root: Path,
    sample: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    scripts = plugin_root / "scripts"
    node_id = sample.get("graph_node_id")
    title = sample.get("title")
    if not isinstance(node_id, str) or not isinstance(title, str):
        raise AuditError("sample feature requires graph_node_id and title")
    description = sample.get("purpose") if isinstance(sample.get("purpose"), str) else title
    body = json.dumps(
        {
            "graph_node_id": node_id,
            "acceptance": sample.get("acceptance", []),
            "implementation_readiness": sample.get("implementation_readiness"),
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
    )
    return {
        "beads": _run_json([
            "python3",
            str(scripts / "bd-bridge.py"),
            "--op",
            "create",
            "--repo-root",
            str(repo_root),
            "--graph-node-id",
            node_id,
            "--title",
            title,
            "--description",
            description,
            "--artifact-kind",
            "feature",
            "--dry-run",
        ]),
        "github_issue": _run_json([
            "python3",
            str(scripts / "gh-bridge.py"),
            "--op",
            "issue-create",
            "--repo",
            "example/dev-graph-live-trial",
            "--title",
            title,
            "--body",
            body,
            "--dry-run",
        ]),
        "github_projects": _run_json([
            "python3",
            str(scripts / "gh-bridge.py"),
            "--op",
            "project-item-add",
            "--content-id",
            node_id,
            "--project-id",
            node_id,
            "--dry-run",
        ]),
    }


def _suppression_from(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    payload = receipt["payload"]
    if payload.get("op") == "create":
        return isinstance(payload.get("dry_run_preview"), dict)
    return payload.get("dry_run") is True and payload.get("mutation_suppressed") is True


def _state_comparison(before: dict[str, Any], after: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    checks = {
        "config_sha_unchanged": before["config"]["sha256"] == after["config"]["sha256"],
        "graph_sha_unchanged": before["graph"]["sha256"] == after["graph"]["sha256"],
        "graph_revision_unchanged": before["graph"]["revision"] == after["graph"]["revision"],
        "graph_node_count_unchanged": before["graph"]["node_count"] == after["graph"]["node_count"],
        "content_inventory_unchanged": before["content_inventory"] == after["content_inventory"],
        "managed_git_status_unchanged": (
            before["git_status"]["managed"] == after["git_status"]["managed"]
        ),
    }
    return {
        "checks": checks,
        "mutation_suppressed": all(checks.values()),
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
    }


def audit(
    *,
    repo_root: Path,
    preview_path: Path,
    scenario_path: Path,
    pre_state_path: Path,
    plugin_root: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    preview = _load_object(preview_path)
    nodes = preview.get("nodes")
    if not isinstance(nodes, list) or not all(isinstance(node, dict) for node in nodes):
        raise AuditError("preview.nodes must be an object array")
    scenarios = _load_object(scenario_path).get("scenarios")
    if not isinstance(scenarios, list):
        raise AuditError("scenario file requires scenarios[]")
    scenario = next(
        (
            item
            for item in scenarios
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("scenario_id") == SCENARIO_ID
        ),
        None,
    )
    if not isinstance(scenario, dict):
        raise AuditError(f"scenario not found: {SCENARIO_ID}")
    threshold = scenario.get("declared_granularity_threshold")
    if not isinstance(threshold, dict):
        raise AuditError("scenario requires declared_granularity_threshold")

    features = [node for node in nodes if node.get("artifact_kind") == "feature"]
    graph = _graph_measurements(nodes, threshold)
    publication = _publication_measurements(features)
    pre_state = _load_object(pre_state_path)
    local = _state_comparison(pre_state, capture_state(repo_root))
    helper = _helper_identity()
    helper_pre = pre_state.get("audit_implementation")
    helper_provenance_valid = (
        isinstance(helper_pre, dict)
        and helper_pre.get("sha256") == helper["sha256"]
        and helper["tracked_in_index"]
        and helper["index_matches_worktree"]
    )
    adapters = _adapter_receipts(repo_root, plugin_root, features[0])
    adapter_suppression = {
        name: _suppression_from(receipt)
        for name, receipt in adapters.items()
    }
    schema = _run_json(
        [
            "python3",
            str(plugin_root / "scripts/validate-graph-schema.py"),
            "--graph",
            "-",
            "--repo-root",
            str(repo_root),
        ],
        stdin=json.dumps(preview, ensure_ascii=False),
    )
    violations = schema["payload"].get("violations")
    if not isinstance(violations, list):
        raise AuditError("schema receipt requires violations[]")
    structural_violations = [
        item
        for item in violations
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("code") != "artifact_missing"
    ]

    suppression = {"local": local["mutation_suppressed"], **adapter_suppression}
    write_counts = {
        name: int(not value)
        for name, value in suppression.items()
    }
    draft_empty = all(
        not result["ids"]
        for result in publication["draft_candidates"].values()
    )
    passed = all([
        bool(nodes),
        bool(features),
        bool(graph["architecture_count"]),
        graph["acyclic"],
        graph["threshold_pass"],
        not bool(graph["task_count"]),
        draft_empty,
        publication["readiness_probe"]["excluded_only_by_readiness"],
        all(suppression.values()),
        not structural_violations,
        helper_provenance_valid,
    ])
    return {
        "scenario_id": SCENARIO_ID,
        "preview": str(preview_path),
        "audit_implementation": {
            **helper,
            "same_as_pre_state": (
                isinstance(helper_pre, dict)
                and helper_pre.get("sha256") == helper["sha256"]
            ),
            "provenance_valid": helper_provenance_valid,
        },
        "graph": graph,
        "publication": publication,
        "local_state": local,
        "adapter_receipts": adapters,
        "mutation_suppression": suppression,
        "derived_write_counts": write_counts,
        "schema_validation": {
            "stdin_path_used": True,
            "receipt": schema,
            "violation_count": len(violations),
            "structural_violations": structural_violations,
            "structural_contract_valid": not structural_violations,
        },
        "pass": passed,
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    snapshot = commands.add_parser("snapshot")
    snapshot.add_argument("--repo-root", required=True, type=Path)
    snapshot.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser = commands.add_parser("audit")
    audit_parser.add_argument("--repo-root", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser.add_argument("--preview", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser.add_argument("--scenario", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser.add_argument("--pre-state", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser.add_argument("--plugin-dir", required=True, type=Path)
    audit_parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.command == "snapshot":
            result = capture_state(args.repo_root.resolve(strict=True))
        else:
            result = audit(
                repo_root=args.repo_root.resolve(strict=True),
                preview_path=args.preview.resolve(strict=True),
                scenario_path=args.scenario.resolve(strict=True),
                pre_state_path=args.pre_state.resolve(strict=True),
                plugin_root=args.plugin_dir.resolve(strict=True),
            )
        _write_object(args.output, result)
    except (AuditError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(str(exc), file=os.sys.stderr)
        return os.EX_DATAERR
    return os.EX_OK


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
